title: AI Document Processing Cost in India
seoTitle: AI Document Processing Cost in India (2026)
seoDescription: What AI invoice and document processing costs in India: reading invoices, POs and forms into Tally or ERP, validation, review screens. Costs and timelines.
summary: AI document processing that reads invoices, purchase orders or forms into your systems typically costs ₹6 lakh to ₹15 lakh for one or two document types posted to Tally or an ERP with a review screen, ₹15 lakh to ₹30 lakh for many document types and sources, plus running costs per document.

Many formats and suppliers, approvals, exception queues, analytics
Documents never leave your servers; GPU hardware or private cloud

dataPoints.label: Accuracy to expect
dataPoints.value: High on typed documents with good scans; lower on handwriting and poor photos

dataPoints.value: GSTIN format, totals and tax arithmetic, supplier master matching

dataPoints.label: Payback
dataPoints.value: Hours of data entry saved and fewer posting errors

body:
## How it works

1. Documents arrive by email, upload or scanner.
2. OCR and an AI model extract fields and line items.
3. Rules validate the data; uncertain items go to a review screen.
4. Approved data posts to Tally or your ERP.

See [AI document processing](/blog/ai-document-processing-automating-invoices-purchase-orders-and-contracts) and our glossary entry on [OCR](/glossary/ocr).

These ranges are indicative for 2026, based on the effort such projects typically take. Your quote depends on your scope, integrations and quality requirements; a short discovery phase turns this into a firm number.

faqs.q: Can it handle supplier invoices in any format?
faqs.a: Yes, modern AI reads varied layouts, but test on your real invoices to measure accuracy.
Choose providers with Indian regions or run models privately if policy requires.
